spans.s:
अ-श्लीक, अस्, आ, अम् (श्ली substituted for श्री), un-
lucky, unpropitious.

अ-श्लील, अस्, आ, अम्, unpleasant, ugly; coarse, vul-
gar; abusive, blackguard; (अम्), n. rustic language,
untruth, low abuse.

अश्लाघा अ-श्लाघा, f. (rt. श्लाघ्), absence of
self-applause, modesty, reserve.

अ-श्लाघ्य or अ-श्लाघनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, unde-
serving of honour or praise, worthless; base, mean.

अश्लेषा अ-श्लेषा, f. (rt. श्लिष्), the ninth
Nakṣatra or lunar mansion, containing five stars;
disunion, disjunction.
—अश्लेषा-भव, अस्, or अश्ले-
षा-भू, ऊस्, m. a N. of Ketu, i. e. the descending
[]
node or dragon's tail; (as formed of the lower ex-
tremities of the Daitya Saiṃhika, who was cut in two
by Viṣṇu at the churning of the ocean.)

अश्लोन अ-श्लोन, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. not lame,
not crippled.

आश्लिष् आ-श्लिष्, cl. 4. P. A. -श्लिष्यति, -ते,
-श्लेष्टुम्, to embrace.

आ-श्लिष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, embraced; embracing, who
or what embraces; connected, interwoven, blended;
attaching to, joining, who or what adheres to; in-
vested, spread; connected as a consequence, deduced,
concluded.
